avatars.name: The Hurt Partner Going It Alone

who_buys: The sample is small: 14 sales calls, only 3 won in full and 5 more closed on a deposit or instalment, so treat these patterns as early signals, not rules. The people who paid were problem-aware, had the person paying on the call, and could say why now; the full wins (a hurt wife alone, a serial cheater, a couple stuck after the affair) all took a smaller first step (the first month or the $500 One Call Session) paid on the call rather than the full $4,500 or $5,400. Men who cheated and came alone all paid something but only in pieces, because money was tight or their wife held it. Non-buyers were mostly couples fresh from the discovery who heard the price before the pitch, compared providers, doubted 12 weeks could rebuild trust or found $1,800 a month too much on one income, plus a serial cheater who wanted to vet Barak first and a grieving woman who was not ready.
icp_gap: The closing doc pictures a couple or one partner ready to rebuild after infidelity who can invest low to mid four figures. Who actually shows up carries far more: past suicidal thoughts, choking and physical violence, bipolar and mania, cancer treatment, a son's recent death, and several on low or single incomes or paying in another currency, with threads showing people asking for licensed therapists and insurance cover. Who actually buys in full is narrower still: someone with their own money who accepts a one-month or one-session start on the call. The script has no step for wellbeing checks or for correcting the setter's price anchor, and both gaps appear in calls that did not close.
